_about: Every page and step the extension recognises or fills (WO32): site -> pages / steps -> selector(s) -> how it is checked. A step is UNVERIFIED ("verified": false) until a dry run on the Mac recorded it working, with what it saw ('seen'). The Python driver publishes only when the steps it needs are verified (same gate as WO30): the supervised publish needs 'submit' (the button, seen exactly once in a successful dry run), the unattended loop also 'after_publish' (the listing page after the click: only a real publish shows it).
